name: fix_aspnet_missing_validation
description: Fixes a minimal API endpoint that throws an unhandled exception (raw 500) instead of returning 400 for missing input
prompts: This is an ASP.NET Core minimal API project (app.csproj targets net8.0). Program.cs already contains a POST /register endpoint that trims and lowercases an email address from the request body, but when the request body is missing the 'email' field or it is null/blank, the current code throws an unhandled exception (a raw HTTP 500 error) instead of returning a proper validation error. Fix Program.cs so that: when 'email' is missing, null, or blank (whitespace-only), the endpoint returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with a JSON body containing an 'error' field (no exception); otherwise it returns HTTP 200 OK with a JSON body {"email": <trimmed, lowercased email>}. Keep the route (/register) and port (8053) unchanged.

test_setup_files.test_register.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['dotnet', 'build', '-c', 'Release', '-o', 'out'], check=True)
dlls = glob.glob('out/*.dll')
dll = [d for d in dlls if 'app' in d.lower()][0]
srv = subprocess.Popen(['dotnet', dll])

def post(body):
    url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8053/register'
    data = json.dumps(body).encode()
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method='POST')
    r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=5) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            payload = json.loads(e.read())
        except Exception:
            payload = {}
        return e.code, payload

try:
    ok = False
    status = None
    payload = None
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            status, payload = post({'email': ' Test@Example.com '})
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8053'
    assert status == 200, f'expected 200 for valid email, got {status}'
    assert payload.get('email') == 'test@example.com', f'unexpected body: {payload!r}'

    status2, payload2 = post({})
    assert status2 == 400, f'expected 400 for missing email, got {status2} body={payload2!r}'
    assert 'error' in payload2, f'expected error field, got {payload2!r}'

    status3, payload3 = post({'email': '   '})
    assert status3 == 400, f'expected 400 for blank email, got {status3} body={payload3!r}'
    assert 'error' in payload3, f'expected error field, got {payload3!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
